items.item_text: At least 7 years of progressively responsible Compensation experience
Experience supporting a represented workforce and interpreting collective bargaining agreements strongly preferred
At least 3 years in a leadership/supervisory role
Experience managing complex compensation projects and cross-functional initiatives
Advanced analytical skills with experience using Excel, compensation databases, HRIS systems and reporting tools

At UCLA Health, one of America’s leading academic medical centers, our people are at the heart of everything we do. The Compensation Manager plays a critical role in supporting the workforce behind exceptional patient care, groundbreaking research, and the education of tomorrow’s health care leaders.

In this role, you will lead compensation operations, union wage implementation, analytics, and process improvement across UCLA Health. You’ll lead a team of compensation professionals and serve as a strategic partner to HR leadership, Labor Relations, HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, and organizational leaders.

You’ll use data, insight, and innovation to create scalable processes, strengthen compensation practices, and help leaders make informed workforce decisions—all while ensuring compliance with organizational policies, collective bargaining agreements, and regulatory requirements.

the final candidate who accepts an offer of employment will be required to disclose if they have been subject to any final administrative or judicial decisions within the last seven years determining that they committed any misconduct; or have filed an appeal of a finding of substantiated misconduct with a previous employer.
Strong knowledge of compensation principles, job evaluation methodologies, salary administration and market pricing
